mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS portfolio_id, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.risk_level, p.strategy_type AS portfolio_strategy_type, p.listed, p.status, p.reject_reason, s.strategyid AS strategy_id, s.name AS strategy_name, s.strategy_type, s.description, s.strategy_ref_id, p.created_at, s.scale, s.funds, s.fee_rate, -- 收益指标从 portfolios 表读取，如果没有则从 strategies 表读取（兼容性） COALESCE(p.return_rate, s.return_rate) AS return_rate, COALESCE(p.annual_return, s.annual_return) AS annual_return, COALESCE(p.volatility, s.volatility) AS volatility, COALESCE(p.sharpe_ratio, s.sharpe_ratio) AS sharpe_ratio, COALESCE(p.max_drawdown, s.max_drawdown) AS max_drawdown, COALESCE(p.win_rate, s.win_rate) AS win_rate FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN strategies s ON p.strategy_id = s.strategy_ref_id ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id AS portfolio_id, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.risk_level, p.strategy_type AS portfolio_strategy_type, p.listed, p.status, p.reject_reason, s.strategyid AS strategy_id, s.name AS strategy_name, s.strategy_type, s.description, s.strategy_ref_id, p.created_at, s.scale, s.funds, s.fee_rate, -- 收益指标从 portfolios 表读取，如果没有则从 strategies 表读取（兼容性） COALESCE(p.return_rate, s.return_rate) AS return_rate, COALESCE(p.annual_return, s.annual_return) AS annual_return, COALESCE(p.volatility, s.volatility) AS volatility, COALESCE(p.sharpe_ratio, s.sharpe_ratio) AS sharpe_ratio, COALESCE(p.max_drawdown, s.max_drawdown) AS max_drawdown, COALESCE(p.win_rate, s.win_rate) AS win_rate FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN strategies s ON p.strategy_id = s.strategy_ref_id WHERE p.id = #{portfolioId}
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET listed = 1, status = 'approved', reject_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND listed = 0
UPDATE portfolios SET listed = -1, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolios (name, risk_level, strategy_type, summary, target_investor, strategy_id, listed, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{riskLevel}, #{strategyType}, #{summary}, #{targetInvestor}, #{strategyId}, 0, 'draft', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET name = #{name}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, strategy_type = #{strategyType}, summary = #{summary}, target_investor = #{targetInvestor}, strategy_id = #{strategyId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, risk_level, strategy_type, summary, target_investor, strategy_id, listed, status, created_at, updated_at, return_rate AS returnRate, annual_return AS annualReturn, max_drawdown AS maxDrawdown, sharpe_ratio AS sharpeRatio, volatility, win_rate AS winRate FROM portfolios WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.risk_level AS riskLevel, p.strategy_type AS strategyType, p.summary AS summary, p.target_investor AS targetInvestor, p.strategy_id AS strategyId, p.listed AS listed, p.status AS status, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, s.fee_rate AS feerate, p.return_rate AS returnRate, p.annual_return AS annualReturn, p.max_drawdown AS maxDrawdown, p.sharpe_ratio AS sharpeRatio, p.volatility AS volatility, p.win_rate AS winRate FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN strategies s ON p.strategy_id = s.strategy_ref_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE portfolios SET return_rate = #{returnRate}, annual_return = #{annualReturn}, max_drawdown = #{maxDrawdown}, sharpe_ratio = #{sharpeRatio}, volatility = #{volatility}, win_rate = #{winRate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{portfolioId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS portfolio_id, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.risk_level, p.strategy_type AS portfolio_strategy_type, p.summary, p.target_investor, p.created_at AS portfolio_created_at, s.name AS strategy_name, s.strategy_type AS strategy_type, -- 订购统计数据 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT so.id), 0) AS total_order_count, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN so.order_status = 'completed' THEN so.id END), 0) AS completed_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(so.subscription_amount), 0) AS total_subscription_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN so.order_status = 'completed' THEN so.subscription_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_subscription_amount, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT so.user_id), 0) AS total_user_count, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN so.subscription_amount IS NOT NULL THEN so.subscription_amount END), 0) AS avg_subscription_amount FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN strategies s ON p.strategy_id = s.strategy_ref_id LEFT JOIN subscription_order so ON p.id = so.portfolio_id WHERE p.listed = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.risk_level, p.strategy_type, p.summary, p.target_investor, p.created_at, s.name, s.strategy_type ORDER BY p.id DESC
